text:
maria: quick heads-up — shifting tonight's deploy window later by 2 hours. Canary ramps are currently overlapping with a scheduled infra maintenance in us-west; moved window to 02:00–04:00 PT. Ping if this blocks any downstream rollouts. :bell:

jonah: noted. ETA for maintenance clear? will that affect batch jobs?

maria: infra team confirmed maintenance end by 01:45 PT. We want a 15m buffer before canary starts. Batch jobs that hit the db during maintenance should be deferred — ops has a migration flag.

ashok: thanks. I've bumped the canary to a single shard and reduced parallelism to 1 to lower risk. If latency > 300ms for 5m we auto-roll back per the SLA rule.

release-bot: Canary started (id: canary-2026-03-23-281234). Initial ramp: 1% traffic -> 5% -> 20% over 30m. Monitors: latency, error-rate, token-cost.

sre-oncall: watching logs. If we see >2% 5xx or pods crashloop -> escalate to #eng-oncall and stop canary.

jonah: pushing a small telemetry tweak; expect a short restart at 02:12 PT. Will post when done.

maria: thanks. If anything noisy happens, abort with `./release ctl canary abort canary-2026-03-23-281234` or use the Console -> Releases -> Abort. I'll keep roll-call here. :eyes:

sre-oncall: latency spike at 02:19 — +120ms on redis calls. Investigating, looks like connection saturation. Lowered canary to 5%.

ashok: I'm throttling the KV cache rebuilds, dropping backfills. Reassessing after 5m.

maria: update — infra fixed a slow node, latency trending down. Keeping canary at 10% for another 10m. If stable, we'll proceed to 50%.

jonah: telemetry restart completed, no errors reported. :thumbsup:

release-bot: Canary ramp to 50% scheduled at 02:45 PT.

maria: final call — anyone see blockers for proceeding to 50% in next 10m? If no objections, we'll proceed. Otherwise call it.

ashok: no objections from infra.

sre-oncall: clear. monitoring dash green.

maria: proceeding to 50% now. I'll post final status in 30m.

release-bot: Canary reached 50% at 02:47 PT. No regression alerts.

maria: rolling to full traffic in the morning window (08:00 PT) unless anything regresses. Thanks all.
